about: tools/showcase/redact.py: OCR terms blurred everywhere, plus fixed boxes [x, y, w, h, from_s, to_s] per still or clip (2560x1440). The personal terms (names, places, networks) are kept outside the repo, in ~/.config/tahoe-glass/showcase-redact-terms.json, and added at run time. The city, the weather widget, the Wi-Fi name and the login name and picture are shown on purpose (user, 2026-10-21).
